HEADER: N Small Fey (Earth, Fire, Water, Wind)
DEFENSE: AC 26, touch 26, flat-footed 14 (+3 deflect, +11 dex, +1 dodge, +1 size)
OFFENSE: Melee Shock +21 touch (2d10 earth, fire, water, or wind damage)
At will (DC 15) - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic
2nd (DC 17) - aero II, fire II, stone II, water II
3rd (DC 18) - aera, aero III, dispel, fira, fire III, stone III, stonera, water III, watera
4th (DC 19) - aero IV, blaze spikes, comet, fire IV, gale spikes, rock spikes, stone IV, torrent spikes, water IV
5th (DC 20) - aeroga, burn, crush, drown, firaga, slice, stonega, waterga
6th (DC 21) - aero IV, blaze spikes, comet, fire IV, gale spikes, rock spikes, stone IV, torrent spikes, water IV
STATISTICS: Str 1, Dex 33, Con 10, Int 20, Wis 16, Cha 14
Feats Alertness, Blind-Fight, Combat Casting, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Spell Penetration, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +29, Bluff +16, Escape Artist +27, Fly +37, Perception +23, Stealth +31
Languages Aklo, Common, Elvaan + 2 others (DM's choice)
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Once every 1d4+1 rounds, the wisp's ability to create a surprisingly pleasant sound not unlike that of a tiny fiddle. The wisp creates a catchy tune that compels any creature within a 20-foot spread to dance and caper. A creature can resist this compulsion by making a successful Will save (DC 24). Creatures that fail are compelled to dance and shuffle their feet, and are effectively staggered for the duration of this spell. Once a creature makes the save against this spell, it is immune to further fiddle effects from that caster for 24 hours. This is a sonic mind-affecting effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 17).
Wisp are immune to all spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance, except spells with the light or dark descriptor.
Wisp have the ability to extinguish their natural glow as a move action, effectively becoming invisible, as per the spell.

parsed.description: A spirit that emanates a light-green glow while floating through the air. In general, how spirits come about is shrouded in mystery, but for the ignis fatuus, there is a theory that they came from a gigantic ignis fatuus discovered deep within a forest, which is believed to be the mother of all the ignis fatuus. That certain ignis fatuus escaped capture, but there is no doubt that its discovery has accelerated ongoing research over the mysteries of spirits.

curation.summary: Ignis Fatuus is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 63 generated item(s) across 6 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
